the-last-shot.title: The Last Shot
the-last-shot.prompt: A lone shooter frozen in a perfect follow-through, wrist bent, fingers pointing at the rim, seen from behind and below against a wall of blinding white light. The whole arena is reduced to one giant glowing scoreboard reading 5.2 in the dark above him. Red figure, black void, white light.

the-block.title: The Block
the-block.prompt: Shot from directly behind the backboard: a hand and forearm slamming a basketball flat against the glass, the shooter's hand still underneath it, both arms stretched to their limit. Wine-red and gold light, the glass cracking into a star pattern around the ball, nothing else in frame.

the-junior-skyhook.title: The Junior Skyhook
the-junior-skyhook.prompt: A point guard mid-stride across the lane, lofting a running one-handed hook, the ball leaving his fingertips in a shaft of gold light, two defenders behind him dissolved into green smoke. Gold figure, green haze, a clock reading :02 burned faintly into the dark.

the-shrug.title: The Shrug
the-shrug.prompt: A player seen from the front, shoulders raised, palms turned up, head tilted, the universal shrug, lit from below like a statue. Six basketballs hang in a perfect row in the air above him like a halo. Red figure on a deep black field.

the-lob.title: The Lob
the-lob.prompt: A basketball hanging at the apex of its arc at the very top of the frame, and far below two giant hands rising to meet it, the rest of the player's body falling into darkness. Gold light, the ball's arc drawn as a thin bright line from the bottom corner. Nothing else.

the-dagger.title: The Dagger
the-dagger.prompt: A shooter at the top of a step-back, the defender's outstretched hand a half-second late, the ball leaving his hand with a long bright trail that turns into the shape of a dagger blade. Wine-red and gold, 53 seconds glowing faintly in the black.

eighty-one.title: Eighty-One
eighty-one.prompt: A guard in purple walking alone off a court, back to camera, the hardwood behind him covered in eighty-one glowing shot marks, each a small burst of light, forming a constellation over the floor. Black arena, purple figure, gold sparks.

the-free-throw-line-dunk.title: From the Line
the-free-throw-line-dunk.prompt: A human basketball player in full flight, body stretched perfectly horizontal, legs split, one arm holding the ball high, drawn as a flat red-and-gold silhouette of an athlete in strict side profile. Below him the free-throw line glows as the only mark on a black floor and a dotted arc traces his flight from the line to a rim at the right edge. A human body with arms and legs, not an object.

the-skyhook.title: The Skyhook
the-skyhook.prompt: An impossibly tall black silhouette seen from far below, elongated like a cathedral spire, releasing a hook shot with one arm straight up, the ball at the very top of the frame, the shot's arc a thin golden line curving toward a rim beyond the edge of the picture. A flat featureless shape against a purple field, gold light. Nothing else in the frame.

the-flu-game.title: The Flu Game
the-flu-game.prompt: A single black silhouette of a basketball player on his knees at centre court, seen from behind, head bowed, one hand flat on the floor, the centre circle glowing beneath him like a halo. Everything else black. One beam of sickly grey-green light from above and a red wash across his back. No other figure in the frame, no equipment of any kind.

the-dream-shake.title: The Dream Shake
the-dream-shake.prompt: A centre on the low block drawn as a multiple exposure: four ghost silhouettes of the same figure pivoting one way, then the other, then rising for the shot, the last one solid. Flat scarlet shapes on black with a glowing gold motion trail. One defender a dim silhouette leaning the wrong way. Blank featureless figures, blank uniforms.

the-logo-three.title: From the Logo
the-logo-three.prompt: A slight guard releasing a jumper from a distance so absurd the rim is a tiny bright circle at the far top of the frame, the ball a glowing dot halfway there, the court stretched to a vanishing point between them. Blue and gold on a black floor, the half-court circle glowing under his feet. The picture fills the whole frame edge to edge with no border, no title band and no caption area.

the-stepover.title: The Stepover
the-stepover.prompt: Shot from floor level: a guard's huge foot and leg stepping over a fallen opponent, the standing guard a solid white silhouette towering out of the top of the frame, the fallen player a flat purple-and-gold shape sprawled across a glowing white floor. One hard spotlight, long hard shadows. Two complete solid silhouettes with blank uniforms.

the-first-team.title: The First Team
the-first-team.prompt: Exactly five colossal silhouettes, five separate figures standing shoulder to shoulder in one line across the horizon of an empty glowing court the size of a city, seen from far away and below like a mountain range, sunset light pouring between them. Each of the five a different colour: black, green, red, purple, gold. The final boss of a climb through basketball history.
